title: Working with Celestin: dates, Bourbon Street and the band's end
summary: He describes steady work in the city, a year at the Paddock on Bourbon Street, Celestin's death and Eddie Pearson taking over, and enjoying Celestin and Morgan best.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Were most of your dates with Salaside on the road or parties around here? Where did you work with Salaside?
Well, with Papa Band, we had plenty of work. Somehow we couldn't do it all. We had work in the city.
for the best white people in town. You never played much on Bourbon Street with him, though. You never played that paddock. Yes, I played that. Did you play there, too? I forgot.
You know you come out a couple times and see me.
Yeah, but I forgot. They started out there with Rickard Alexis for a while, didn't they?
Yes. Well, Rickard was his best player.
But didn't he have two bands? That's what I'm trying to find out. Didn't Papa have one band for the parties and one for the paddock for a while? Something like that? I don't know.
I heard that they had two bands, but I wouldn't know anything about them.
That's what I wondered.
I don't know him. I know he had one band. I hear fellas say he had two.

That's right. I remember I used to see you, of course, on Bourbon Street, different places. I forgot the paddock. I remember last time I saw you was down there at the band's Pier 600, I think, along in there.
That was by Dan.
Yeah.
Yeah, I played at the paddock on Mary about a little better than a year.
You were there that long?
That was young.
Mm-hmm.

And after that, well, he said he were getting too old to fool around Bourbon Street. And he said, well, I'll pull the band out of Bourbon Street. And because I have enough work for you fellas to make a living without working on Bourbon Street. Mm-hmm. Well, a few years after that, Papa died.
Yep.
And, well, Eddie took the band over. And he run it for a while. And then, you know, about four years, wasn't it? Mm-hmm. Between then and then.
Yeah, I think so.

Yeah, Eddie run the band. And Eddie left. And then next year, then I left. That was it. So that really, I really enjoy that band, Papa Celeste and Sam Morgan band. I really, that's two bands I really enjoy because I stayed with Sam a long time and I stayed with Papa. Yeah. Good while. Yeah, Papa had pretty good bands. He always had good musicians.
